notes.title: Now Available - Guns of Icarus Online
notes.notes:
Guns of Icarus Online is Now Available on Steam.

It’s not an easy life, but there’s nothing else like it. Plenty of folks like yourself have decided to slip the surly bonds of earth and take to the skies after hearing tales of bold Captains, fearless Gunners, and cunning Engineers and their high-flying exploits. Think you have what it takes to join their ranks?

Raising the stakes on team-based PvP combat with an emphasis on strategic competition and truly cooperative play, Guns of Icarus Online is the premier airship combat game that’s all about teamwork, tactics, and fast-paced action. With a good ship and the right crew, you can conquer the skies!

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - Guns of Icarus Online, 25% Off!
notes.notes:
Pre-Purchase Guns of Icarus Online Now and get 25% Off* and Immediate Access to the Beta on Steam!

Guns of Icarus Online is a team-based multiplayer online airship combat game set in a steampunk/dieselpunk-inspired, post-apocalyptic world. Captain or serve as crew aboard an airship with your friends and fly into battle for wealth and glory!

On an airship, everyone has a job to do, and the whole crew must work together to take down enemies and keep the ship flying. Multiple roles offer challenges to appeal to players of all stripes, uniting genres and creating a surprisingly diverse gaming experience. Maximize your firepower and deal punishing damage as Gunner, work fast under pressure and keep the ship together as Engineer, or execute cunning aeronautical strategies and lead your crew to victory as Captain.

Raising the stakes on team-based PvP combat with an emphasis on strategic competition and truly cooperative play, Guns of Icarus Online is all about teamwork, tactics, and fast-paced action. With a good ship and the right crew, you can dominate the skies!

*Offer ends September 30th at 10AM Pacific Time.
